name: Northstar Money
description:
NORTHSTAR – PERSONALIZED FINANCIAL GUIDANCE

Northstar helps you build a healthier relationship with your money through personalized guidance, clear action steps, and real human support.

Designed to meet you where you are, Northstar simplifies complex financial decisions and helps you move forward with confidence. Whether you’re managing everyday finances, navigating benefits, planning for retirement, or preparing for life changes, Northstar gives you clarity and direction.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH NORTHSTAR

1-ON-1 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE
 Get access to a credentialed financial advisor (CFP) through secure chat, phone, or video. Northstar advisors act as fiduciaries and provide personalized guidance without commissions or product sales, tailored to your goals and life stage.

PERSONALIZED ACTION PLANS
 Turn goals into clear, actionable next steps. Northstar helps you focus on what matters most right now, without long questionnaires, complex charts, or overwhelming documents.

A CLEAR FINANCIAL PICTURE
 See your financial life in one place. Understand your income, spending, savings, and progress toward your goals with intuitive tools that support informed decision-making.

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION INSIGHTS
 Make sense of your total compensation, including employer benefits. Get guidance on health plans, retirement savings, equity, and other benefits so you can make confident choices.

SUPPORT THROUGH LIFE’S FINANCIAL MOMENTS
 From starting a new job to buying a home, growing your family, or planning for retirement, Northstar adapts as your life changes and your financial needs evolve.

WHY PEOPLE TRUST NORTHSTAR
 Northstar was built to make financial guidance clear, accessible, and aligned with your goals. We prioritize clarity over jargon and guidance over pressure, so you can feel informed and in control of your money.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
 Your data is protected with industry-standard security and encryption. Your financial information is private and always under your control.

Get started with Northstar today and take the next step toward financial confidence.

name: Bible Devotional: North Star
description:
North Star: A Christian AI app for daily faith

North Star helps you slow down, open Scripture, and walk with God every day. It brings together personalised devotionals, structured Bible reading plans, a private prayer life, and an honest space to journal, all shaped by pastoral teaching tradition.

KEY FEATURES

• Daily devotionals personalised by North Star AI - name, faith stage, and the teaching tradition you choose
• 12 Bible reading plans across 4 depth levels (Beginner to Expert): Psalms, Sermon on the Mount, Life of Jesus, Paul's Letters, Names of God, Walking with Abraham, Fruit of the Spirit, Lord's Prayer, Proverbs, Letters to the Churches, Easter, Advent
• Faith journal with warm, Scripture-grounded reflection on what you write
• Gentle on-topic reflection prompts
• Prayer requests, gratitude entries, and a shared prayer wall
• Read any Bible chapter in 10 translations, with audio in ESV, KJV and WEB, plus the NKJV New Testament
• Ask anything about faith, God or Scripture, and highlight or note any verse as you read
• Quiet design: streaks and day counts that encourage faithfulness, never guilt

WHY NORTH STAR

Most Bible apps either feel cold or push at you. North Star is built for quiet, daily faithfulness. Christ-centred, Scripture-saturated, pastoral in tone. Powered by modern AI that has been carefully prompted to deepen your reflection, never replace it. Every devotional and every reading plan stays grounded in the biblical text and the gospel.

PREMIUM & FREE

The free tier includes core reading plans, daily devotionals, and journaling. Premium adds deeper personalised guidance, all 4 reading-plan depth levels, and is generous within published fair-use limits. A 7-day free trial is available from the App Store on monthly or annual Premium.

PRIVACY

Your journal, prayers, and reflections are encrypted at rest. The reflection engine sees only what you share with it directly, and only for the response you are seeing right now. We do not sell your data.

QUESTIONS

We read every message at anthony@ajsoftwaredev.org.

name: North Star: Goals & Habits
description:
North Star helps you keep track of all of your goals — everything from landing your dream job to sticking with your New Year’s resolutions. Pick any combination of tools and track progress at your own pace. 

- We support all types of goals -
Whatever it is that you want to achieve — ie., live healthier, buy a new car, learn to code, etc. — belongs in North Star. 

- We’ll keep track of your progress and help you stay organized -
How do you currently keep track of your goals? Do you use different apps? Make mental notes? Write them down on a sticky note that ends up at the bottom of your pocket? 

We’ve simplified the process by creating customizable tools — think of them as ‘‘mini apps’’ that you can activate:

- Habits: plan and track activities you want to do consistently
- Milestones: divide your goal into achievable steps 
- Measures: track results over time to measure progress 
- Planner: create to-do lists and set reminders

The app is fully functional even if you only activate one tool. You can create and track as many goals as you want. Your goals are separated into different views, each containing different sets of tools.

With North Star you’ll have more energy to achieve your goals. 

-------

**No email, no signup, no spam**
We don't store or send your data. Privacy first! 

-------

Subscription

North Star is free to download. After a 7-day free trial, we offer 3 different plans to continue using North star: 

1 month: $5.00/mo.
1 year: $2.50/mo. ($35.00 per year)
Lifetime: $50.00

The total cost of the purchase will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription period will automatically renew unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. 

Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. If you wish to stop subscribing, we’ll help you out. You can cancel your subscription anytime through the subscription page in North Star.

Enter a vast, underwater cosmos: a mysterious interconnected world of tentacles, sharp teeth, and black ink, where your survival depends on your ability to adapt in a continually changing environment.
